newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market up $0.50-$1.00 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market up $0.50-$1.00 - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were $0.50-$1.00 per cwt higher, compared with Monday's close, USDA said. Trade moderate. Demand moderate to good. Seller interest light to moderate. Offerings light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1250 lbs 1.5 lds lower dressing 70.50. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1075-1200 lbs 71.00-72.00.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared Mondays close - Slaughter steers and heifers $1.00, instances $2.00 higher.
